name: daily-notes-stream
description: Read your existing daily notes as a read-only journal timeline with infinite scroll, on desktop and mobile. Uses your Daily notes or Periodic Notes settings. Search all notes or jump to a date.

scripts.build:device: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && export BUILD_LABEL="$(node scripts/build-name.mjs)" && echo "Notice on load: $BUILD_LABEL" && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:e2e && playwright test
scripts.test:ios: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:e2e && playwright test -c playwright.ios.config.ts
scripts.capture:screenshots: pnpm run build && CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 E2E_SHOW_WINDOW=1 playwright test screenshots.spec.ts
scripts.capture:listing: pnpm run build && CAPTURE_LISTING=1 E2E_SHOW_WINDOW=1 playwright test listing.spec.ts && node scripts/listing-cards.mjs
scripts.capture:recording: pnpm run build && CAPTURE_RECORDING=1 E2E_SHOW_WINDOW=1 playwright test recording.spec.ts --project=desktop
scripts.capture:recording:ios: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:e2e && CAPTURE_RECORDING=1 playwright test -c playwright.ios.config.ts recording.spec.ts
scripts.test:memory: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:e2e && E2E_SEED_DAYS=1825 playwright test memory.spec.ts render-cost.spec.ts edit-cost.spec.ts
